title: Influence of Annealing on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Refractory CoCrMoNbTi0.4 High-Entropy Alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting a mixture of commercially pure metals under Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere on a water-cooled Cu hearth. The alloy was re-melted at least five times to ensure chemical homogeneity. The as-cast samples were sealed in a vacuum quartz tube and subsequently annealed in a muffled electric resistant furnace at 1073 K, 1273 K, and 1473 K for 20 hours, respectively.
